patch_list: Removes the ads from T-Mobile Play's feeds and stops the ad networks from loading.
Stops T-Mobile Play's usage events, Firebase Analytics, and Apptentive surveys. Sign-in and the feeds are left alone. Opt-in; test on-device.
Stops Vizbee, which scans your home network for TVs and reports them with your device ID. Sending video to a TV from T-Mobile Play will not work. Opt-in; test on-device.

Gives the app a random per-install Android ID instead of your device's, and reports a zeroed advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you had deleted your ad ID in Android settings. The video DRM ID is left alone so playback works. O…
Removes the Storyteller stories and video clips from T-Mobile Play's feeds. Opt-in; test on-device.
